newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes hit in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes hit in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes rocketed suspected guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Sunday hours after guerrillas wounded three Israeli soldiers in an attack, Lebanese security sources said.

They said the planes fired at least three rockets into Jabal Safi in highlands used by pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas to attack Israeli forces occupying a border zone to the south. There was no immediate report of casualties.
The raid came hours after three Israeli soldiers were wounded, one seriously, by anti-tank fire from Hizbollah guerrillas in the south Lebanon zone.
On Saturday, the Shi'ite Moslem guerrillas killed an Israeli soldier and wounded two with machinegun and anti-tank rocket fire at an Israeli post in the border zone.

Hizbollah, which wages a guerrilla war in a bid to oust Israeli and allied militia forces from the 15-km (nine-mile) deep buffer strip in south Lebanon, claimed responsibility for Saturday and Sunday's assaults.
